# Barber kit

Type: Material | Internal ID: Barberkit | Source: Hildir | Usage: Building | Buy: 600, Coins | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Barber kit is an item which got introduced in the Hildir's Request update. It is used to construct the Barber station and is unlocked by default.

## Availability

• Purchased from the trader Hildir for 600 Coins each.

### Building

• Barber station
